RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Only fifth and ninth but in stronger races than this at Newbury and Goodwood (both over 6f); showed pace in both.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Tailed off in his two races at odds of 33-1 and 150-1 respectively.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: £30,000 breeze-up 2yo (private sale); 20-1 when withdrawn on intended debut after getting upset in the stalls; drawn widest.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Clear promise on debut and latest run at Chester was better than it looks having raced up with the pace before fading; now gelded and wears a tongue-tie; possibilities.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: 125-1 for his C&D debut and managed only seventh, finishing behind Lexington Boom.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Modest so far and comfortably held by Lexington Boom on their recent course clash.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Runner-up in 5f maidens at Musselburgh and here, last time finishing clear of the third despite a troubled passage; not ideally drawn in 12 but has good form claims.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Hasn't progressed from finishing second of four behind a useful horse on debut; he could turn a corner now gelded; market may be informative.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Couldn't recommend after her heavy defeat here 23 days ago when 28-1.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to winners Canaria Queen (5f/5.5f; RPR 74) and Canaria Prince (5f; 64); dam tough 5f/6f winner (98), out of 5f winning half-sister to 5f/6f Listed winner Angus Newz; yard's newcomers usually best watched but speedy pedigree and well drawn in one.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Beaten 2l in a seller last time but that form still reads okay in this company; wears a first-time hood.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: First foal out of a 5f 2yo winner (RPR 79) and half-sister to 6f-7.3f winner Burdett; would need to see some confidence behind her.

RaceName: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restriced Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Performed to a modest level when well down the field over an extended 6f at Doncaster (12-1).

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Beaten at triple-figure odds in two maiden runs to date; probably safe to rule out.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Ran with credit on her AW debut when fourth behind a decent type; reportedly failed to handle soft conditions at Cork in May when tailed off (1m3f, soft); better effort at Ballinrobe last time when third, but it wasn't particularly progressive; cheekpieces are added to the tongue tie now but others are better weighted.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Good third at Fairyhouse in early July and backed that up when winning at the Galway festival later in the month (1m1f, yielding to soft); couldn't back it up in similar contest under a 7lb penalty two days later but was a creditable fifth; others are better weighted but he's in form.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Promising third of ten on AW debut in January (6f); returned from a break at Fairyhouse next time when a 16l fifth of 15 (7f, good), shaping like he would come on; drops into claimer company but he's not up for claiming so looks dangerous; wide draw to overcome, however.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
OwnerName: David K Kelly & Mrs Pauline Condon
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden has gone close a couple of times this term; second in a 7.5f maiden claimer at Roscommon before runner-up in a C&D maiden in June; took third back at Roscommon next time; posted a similar RPR when sixth of 13 in a C&D maiden here last time; top chance at these weights.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Best run for this yard was when runner-up over 1m1f in a Leopardstown handicap last summer (soft); lost form after that and was well beaten on his seasonal return last month at Leopardstown; visor goes on and has been given a chance at the weightings but you'd like to see more positive recent form.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Versatile sort has won a chase, over hurdles and on the Flat; soundly beaten in final start for Gavin Cromwell at Thurles (2m, good) in October and off since; best watched in first run for new yard.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Landed back-to-back 1m claimers at Bellewstown and Killarney in July when beating a few of these; couldn't do three in a row at Ballinrobe when third; didn't transfer that form to handicaps at Galway last time; dangerous in these races though; drawn wide.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Soundly beaten in third on her Limerick debut; some improvement over C&D next time when seventh of 13; comes up against more experienced types now but unexposed; wide draw.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Off the mark at Ayr in May when landing a 1m1f handicap off 63; some decent runs since, most notably when 1l behind Minaun View in a Ballinrobe claimer in July; finished further behind that rival at Killarney next time and posted a moderate effort in a Naas handicap latest.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Seven-time winner but hasn't scored since May 2024 and has been off since running well to finish third in a Ballinrobe claimer in July last year; record when fresh suggests he might need this.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: AW winner in January has run some good races in defeat for this yard; second at Limerick in June (1m, yielding) but her run over C&D two days later probably came too soon; another promising effort at Killarney last time when defeated by a head (1m, good); wears a first-time visor; chance.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: 1-11 on Flat after landing a 7f course maiden in April 2024; just 1.5l behind Minaun View in a Bellewstown claimer in July (1m, good) and better off at weights now; well beaten at Galway latest (7f, yielding).

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Won a Goodwood novice for James Horton; not beaten far at the Curragh over 1m on penultimate but her run at Galway (1m1f, yielding) was a step backwards when drawn wide; not ruled out from a good draw.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Shaped creditably on C&D handicap debut in June when third; below that in a Fairyhouse claimer last time (1m2f, good, 100-30); tongue tie worn that day is left off for her stable debut here.

RaceName: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
Spotlight: Front-running fifth at 200-1 in a 9.5f Ballinrobe maiden on penutlimate looks like a bit of an aberration based on overall form; hard to make a case for.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: He has run to a modest level in two novice runs this summer, both over 6f (good/good to firm); bred to stay further and nurseries over 7f+ may see him in a better light.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promise amidst inexperience on his debut at Yarmouth (6f, good) in May; thrown in the deep end in the Group 2 Coventry Stakes eight weeks ago and finished well beaten, albeit his track position wasn't ideal; capable of further progress.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Yet to land a blow in two novice runs this summer, the latest at Ffos Las (7.4f, good) last week; others bring more pressing claims.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Modest RPRs in two starts this summer (6f, good and good to firm), in need of the experience on each occasion; may need more time.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: No better than midfield in two 6f novices (soft and good to firm) this summer; latest effort was better but another good step forward will be required to win.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Recorded RPRs in the low 40s in his two runs last month (both 6f on good to firm); the addition of a hood isn't enough to tempt.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Comfortably held in two starts at Kempton (6f, Polytrack); pedigree suggests handicaps over much further may suit in due course.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 70,000euros yearling, 125,000gns breeze-up 2yo; second foal; half-brother to 7f/1m winner Sea Suite (including 2yo; RPR 88); dam 1m5f winner (64), half-sister to Listed winners Ayrad (1m2f/1m4f) and Dawn Of Hope (9.5f); bred for 7f+ but he starts out at a realistic level so needs a market check.

RaceName: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to six winners including See The Fire (7f-1m2f including 2yo/Group 2; RPR 121), Venetian Prince (7f 2yo/1m3f Group 2 Italian Derby; 105) and Spirit Mixer (1m4f-2m including AW; 104); dam 5f-1m2f winner (including 2yo/Group 1; 116); striking pedigree, although likely for further, and stable have won this race in two of the last four seasons (both winners had previous experience).

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: 65,000euros yearling; caught the eye in the paddock and in the race when fourth at Doncaster (7f) and that form has worked out well; ran green so improvement looks on the cards.

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Competitive in his last three races, the latest a 6f nursery at Ripon on first run after being gelded; looks ready for 7f.

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: 55,000gns yearling; fourth foal; brother to winners Quebella (8.6f; RPR 91) and Star Studied (1m; 89), half-brother to 6f AW winner Henriette Ronner (66); dam 1m-1m4f winner, out of Italian 1m2f Group 1 winner; nice pedigree and needs checking in the betting.

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-brother to French 1m1f winner Starzo Fal; dam French 1m2f 2yo winner, half-sister to 1m4f Listed winner Merveillo; he's not kicking off in a strong race so hard to dismiss.

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Beaten 11l when sixth of eight on debut but that was at York (7f) and this should be easier.

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: In rear throughout on 6f debut but raced prominently when fourth of ten at Southwell (7f); shouldn't be too far away if repeating that effort.

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Weak in the betting for her runs here and at Southwell (at about 7f) and likely that a nursery will be next.

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Beaten about 12l in a small field over 5f here a month ago when 22-1; soon up in trip.

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Already looks limited, last time finishing well behind in a field of four; has raced over 7f, 6f and latterly 5f.

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Beaten about 29l and 18l in two maidens over 7f; no appeal for now.

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Both runs over this far, the best on debut when fourth of nine on the AW; has to improve.

RaceName: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: 16,000gns yearling; second foal out of a French 1m4f winner; yard's newcomers usually best monitored.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Belied odds of 25-1 to run a massive race at Fairyhouse on debut (6f, good) on debut, finding one rival (who had the benefit of a run) too good; sent off the 2-1 favourite at Navan (6f, good) off the back of that but didn't find the expected improvement when fifth of 17; must carry top weight once again here.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Saxon Warrior colt; 10,000euros yearling; second foal; dam French 10.5f winner (RPR 98), sister to Japanese 6f winner Eternal Blaze, half-sister to 6f 2yo/1m winner Centre Court, out of French Group-placed 10.5f/1m4f winner; best watched for debut.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Dwelt at start when never a factor on 7.5f Roscommon debut four weeks ago; didn't improve at Fairyhouse next time having been gelded; others preferred.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Ran on late in his Leopardstown debut (6.5f, good) when within 3.75l of fellow debutant Not You Too; should come on for that outing and may turn around that form.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Olympiad filly cost 300,000USD at Ocala in March; faded badly at Listowel on her debut (6.5f, good); improved to take second at Leopardstown next time, albeit no match for the winner; had the debuting Miss Twilight just a neck behind that day; the visor is reached for in the quest for more now; drawn wide.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Holy Roman Emperor colt; 3,000euros foal, 22,000euros yearling; seventh foal; half-brother to winners Shamastar (KSA 6f) and Albayaader (US 6.5f); dam unraced half-sister to 1m4f Group 3 winner Muntahaa, out of French 1m3f Listed winner; market best guide on debut.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Outran odds of 66-1 on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good), keeping on nicely from the back for a 4l fifth of 12; was 3.5l behind third Sea Of Rain, who beat Citrus Springs by the same distance in a Leopardstown maiden next time; could go well from good draw.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Beat just one rival on his debut at Bellewstown over 1m; others more likely.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Has beaten very few rivals in two maidens; safe enough to rule out.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Ten Sovereigns colt holds a Group 1 entry in September; 47,000GBP yearling; third foal; brother to 1m AW winner Snapaurum (RPR 89); dam 1m winner/Group 3 placed at 1m4f (102), half-sister to winners Snapraeterea (7f/7.5f Listed) and Pedisnap (7f/1m), out of 6.5f-1m1f winner; Browne McMonagle chooses the more experienced Citrus Springs.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 125,000gns yearling chased home a 1-3 chance on her debut at Leopardstown (6.5f, good); she was 9l behind but it was a creditable effort all the same (This That 3.75l behind); should improve for that experience and is in the mix.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 40-1 and faded after racing prominently on debut at Down Royal (7f, soft); may need more time.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Footstepsinthesand filly; 25,000euros yearling; second foal; dam 6f-1m maiden (RPR 67), sister to 6f 2yo winner Ginbar, half-sister to 1m Listed winner Magical Dreamer, out of German 1m winner; market can sort trainer's two.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 20,000euros yearling; first foal; dam German 1m1f winner, half-sister to winners Vif Monsieur (German 1m2f/1m4f Group 3), Vive Ma Fille (Listed-placed 1m4f) and Vision Clear (1m4f Flat/2m hurdle).

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Lost ground at the start when tailed off at Leopardstown, but a bit better at Sligo; not of interest in this contest though.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive 2yo/3yo; he has faced some stiff tasks for his new yard this year and has come up short; his sights are lowered here, however, and 6f on fast ground won't faze him; respected now down into a 0-90 with headgear dispensed with.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins as a 3yo, the latter a C&D handicap off 1lb lower last October; good runs in defeat on his last two starts (7f, soft and good to firm); should make another bold bid.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Landed 6f novices at Kempton and Ripon before posting an excellent fourth in York's Lowther Stakes last August; down the field on her return but fared much better when fourth at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 16 days ago; yard going well and the fitting of a tongue-tie may help; key player.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Turned over at long odds-on at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) on his return from a year on the sidelines; finished just in front of Dandana when third at Windsor on last month's handicap debut; still has time to deliver a bigger performance.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Had some solid form as a 2yo and he belatedly shed his maiden tag with a C&D (good ground) win in May; only eighth in a big-field handicap at York 60 days ago; eased in grade but needs to raise his game to win.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: More exposed than most but he is down in the weights and his latest Windsor fourth can be upgraded as he had to wait for a gap to appear; this is a higher grade though.

RaceName: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Class 5 over C&D (soft) in June and followed that with three runner-up finishes; beaten favourite at Goodwood a fortnight ago but he was racing away from the main action and shaped as though still in top form; Oisin Murphy retains the ride; solid claims.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: Formerly with Roger Varian; now 0-13 but ran well for a long way over 1m at Pontefract last time; probably has a race in her off this mark.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: On another career-low mark after a 4l third at Doncaster (7f) where he travelled well but didn't finish with any great purpose; 1-19 and has a wide draw.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: His three turf wins have come around here so that's a positive and twice finished second this year; possibilities back here from a handy draw.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: Four of his five wins have been on the AW, the latest at Southwell in May (7f; 2lb lower); can be inconsistent and doesn't have the best of draws.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice last season (6f, good to firm; 7f, soft) but she's not been shaping as though about to win again; perhaps the new visor will assist.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't been running too badly over 5f, beaten under 3l in her last three races; whether she'll get this far remains to be seen.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: Only 1-25; the blinkers were left off when going close over 6f at Thirsk last week; that was a classified race and he's probably better at 6f than 7f.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: Well treated on last year's form but hasn't got anything going since moving yards; now goes in cheekpieces.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: Showed improved form when a visor was first fitted; no further progress kept to turf since but today's change of headgear may have positive effect.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: Has done most of her winning on the AW and recent turf form is uninspiring; others preferred.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: Modest form so far, including in two handicaps; tried cheekpieces last time and they're left off; new trainer but same owners.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: No wins in nine and well behind in six races since finishing second in a maiden last September; has tried cheekpieces and a visor in last two races.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: Close up over 5f here three runs back but signed off for Joey Ramsden with two quiet runs; no headgear this time and there are stamina queries.

RaceName: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
Spotlight: Has slipped back into modest mode since winning over 6f at Carlisle in May and has stamina to prove over this far.

RaceName: FINAL FURLONG PODCAST WITH 1XBET Handicap
Spotlight: Carries a 7lb penalty due to his C&D victory five days ago; that win came following a good third at the Galway festival (7f, yielding) but he's not the most consistent overall, so not guaranteed to reproduce his winning form.

RaceName: FINAL FURLONG PODCAST WITH 1XBET Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark on seasonal return in a Curragh handicap (1m, good), making all in dominant fashion; hit hard for that with a 10lb rise and came up short in a premier handicap back at the Curragh latest (1m, good, 9-2); that run looked too bad to be true and was found to be coughing post-race; drops in trip but she's interesting if rebounding.

RaceName: FINAL FURLONG PODCAST WITH 1XBET Handicap
Spotlight: Both turf wins came on quick ground at 7f-1m at Ayr; posted a career best when only caught late on in a 17-runner 7f Curragh handicap in June when ahead of a few of these; her run at Naas next time was below that (7f, good) good claims on that Curragh effort.

RaceName: FINAL FURLONG PODCAST WITH 1XBET Handicap
OwnerName: Thomas J O'Connor & Ms Hazel McGuinness
Spotlight: Behind Indigo Dream and Little Empire at the Curragh in June (7f, good); good third at Fairyhouse next time (7f, good) but her form has taken a nosedive in two runs since then; needs to get back on track but the jockey booking is interesting.

RaceName: FINAL FURLONG PODCAST WITH 1XBET Handicap
Spotlight: AW maiden winner has to get her head in front on turf (0-11) but has run some fine races in defeat; not a bad effort when fourth at the Curragh in June (7f, good), 3l behind Little Empire; ran poorly in an added tongue tie (retained) at Fairyhouse last time; others preferred.

RaceName: FINAL FURLONG PODCAST WITH 1XBET Handicap
Spotlight: In excellent form at Dundalk earlier this year; 0-9 on turf and moderate effort at Naas (6f, good) on return from 124 days off on latest; should strip fitter now and 7f more suitable so not totally discounted.

RaceName: FINAL FURLONG PODCAST WITH 1XBET Handicap
Spotlight: Beaten favourite in all four handicap starts for Owen Burrows; okay stable debut at Naas (6f, good); never better than midfield at the Curragh on Sunday (6f, good to firm); this comes quick enough.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: 11-1 winner on debut at Kempton (6f, AW) in June and beaten just over 3l when fifth of ten at 40-1 in Listed race at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last month; he's closely matched with the Ascot third Dandyman Dan and there's stamina in his pedigree; not ruled out now tackling 1m.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Chepstow debut winner (6f, good to soft) who rallied for a good third in Sandown novice (7f, good) last month; suffered interference when mid-division on recent nursery debut at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good to firm) but nevertheless looks up against it in today's company.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Rallied to win on debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month and followed up in Sandown novice (7f, good to firm); both wins have been pretty tight but he has a good attitude and this Sea The Stars colt could relish today's extra furlong, with his dam a 1m 2yo Listed winner.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Belied his 22-1 odds and a slow start to win a six-runner novice on his debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; it was a performance in keeping with his useful pedigree and he could have plenty more to offer, especially now up to 1m; possible contender.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Third on debut at Newmarket's July meeting (7f, good to firm) and won at Chester (7f, good) subsequently; this is a tougher test of his credentials but his trainer has a useful 2yo team and he may be suited by 1m; chance.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Runner-up on first three starts before winning a fillies' maiden at 2-1 at Newmarket's July meeting (7f, good to firm); the Newmarket runner-up has since finished third in a Listed race and she's in good hands to continue to progress; not discounted.

RaceName: Faucets The Bathroom Specialists Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to winners Matloob (5f AW 2yo; RPR 82) and Dangherecomesshang (US 5.5f/6f turf/dirt); dam 4.5f dirt/5f turf (Group 2 Norfolk Stakes) 2yo winner (103); worth a market check but would be a rare first-time-out winner for the stable.

RaceName: Faucets The Bathroom Specialists Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Useful 2yo; has regressed this season and is now 0-8 but was only beaten about 3l when dropped back to 6f for 0-85 Newmarket handicap (good to firm) in June and has good chance at the weights here.

RaceName: Faucets The Bathroom Specialists Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Int Plywood (lmporters) Ltd And C Mason
Spotlight: Showed her inexperience and made a low-key debut when sixth of seven here (5f, good) last month; upped in trip today.

RaceName: Faucets The Bathroom Specialists Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Absent since disappointing nursery debut in December (7f, AW) but displayed improvement when close third in Wolverhampton novice (6f, AW) in November and will play a major role if in similar form here.

RaceName: Faucets The Bathroom Specialists Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £130,000 yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to winners No Half Measures (5f/6f including 2yo/Group 1 July Cup; RPR 119) and Trilby (5f/6f; 91); dam placed 7f AW 2yo (68), half-sister to 8.6f-1m4f winner Dubai Bounty (dam of 5f Group 3 winner Kachy); doesn't need to be anything special to pose a threat on debut.

RaceName: Jill Willows Handicap
Spotlight: Has done well for this yard, in handicaps from 6f to 1m; he wasn't beaten far in a big field at York two runs ago after hitting some traffic and the winner (favourite) got first run on him when closing fast in a recent claimer at Chester (front two dominated); good chance off this mark back in a handicap, especially with Conor Whiteley taking off 5lb.

RaceName: Jill Willows Handicap
OwnerName: Ursa Major Racing Ltd & Julie Camacho
Spotlight: Infrequent winner who is usually held up (can start slowly) and he needs everything to drop right; capable off this mark but if missing the kick from stall 1 he could be behind the black ball.

RaceName: Jill Willows Handicap
OwnerName: SBK Racing & B & J Parr Racing Ltd
Spotlight: Races prominently; easy winner of this 12 months ago when only 2lb lower and he returns on the back of some solid efforts, the latest over 6f which has to bode well; good chance.

RaceName: Jill Willows Handicap
Spotlight: A third win this year when scoring by a length here last month and reportedly never travelled next time at Chester; could be given another chance, though the draw is not ideal.

RaceName: Jill Willows Handicap
Spotlight: Course winner in May and only a length away at Carlisle three starts later; not sure what happened at Thirsk 11 days ago but has a big run in him.

RaceName: Jill Willows Handicap
OwnerName: Rise One Racing - Style Of Life
Spotlight: Three wins from an extended 7f to 1m for current yard; seemed to need the run at York on seasonal debut, though that was three months ago.

RaceName: Jill Willows Handicap
Spotlight: Versatile tactically and his last win was here in June; 6lb higher now but was runner-up off this mark at Lingfield four days ago (7f AW) when in first-time cheekpieces; each-way claims.

RaceName: Jill Willows Handicap
Spotlight: 3-21 on the AW but 0-16 on the grass, never in the first two; beaten about 10l in last two races; not hard to turn elsewhere.

RaceName: Jill Willows Handicap
Spotlight: Made all at Catterick (7f; 3lb lower) but couldn't repeat the trick over Ripon's 1m and he stays that far; however, not all horses take to Ripon and no surprise should he run well.

RaceName: Jill Willows Handicap
Spotlight: Arrives here in a consistent run of form and was bang there when fourth at Redcar latest (1m); probably better over a stiff 7f so firmly in the mix.

RaceName: Jill Willows Handicap
Spotlight: Hurtling down the weights but for good reason as this multiple winner is looking very regressive.

RaceName: Darley Irish EBF Hurry Harriet Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won a 7f AW maiden on debut in September 2024; well-held in four runs last year in good-class company; poor on her return at Dundalk but better in a C&D conditions race last time when chasing home an odds-on favourite; one of the lesser likely candidates all the same.

RaceName: Darley Irish EBF Hurry Harriet Stakes (Listed Race)
OwnerName: H R D McCalmont & Hamish McCalmont & Andrew N C Bengough
Spotlight: Record of 0-14 for current yard but her form in Listed races this term is encouraging; finished second over C&D in May (0.5l in front of Subsonic); another positive third over 1m4f at Pontefract last time; the fact Browne McMonagle rides her ahead of Star Performer is a big boost to her chances.

RaceName: Darley Irish EBF Hurry Harriet Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won a 1m2f Curragh maiden in September (yielding to soft); good third on seasonal return over C&D in a Listed contest in May but soundly beaten in a similar race at Navan next time and a Curragh Group 3 last month (1m2f, good to firm); cheekpieces replace the hood worn the last day; place chance.

RaceName: Darley Irish EBF Hurry Harriet Stakes (Listed Race)
OwnerName: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
Spotlight: Lived up to her name on debut at Galway last October (1m1f, soft to heavy) when powering 3.75l clear late on to beat a better-fancied stablemate in third; blinkers worn that day are left on but this will be very different to the conditions she excelled in at Galway.

RaceName: Darley Irish EBF Hurry Harriet Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Frankel filly ran seven times at two, opening her account on the final start when odds-on in a 7f maiden at Leopardstown; made a poor seasonal return in a Navan Group 3 (1m2f, good to yielding) in April when sixth of seven and beaten 12l; her official rating looks a little flattering.

RaceName: Darley Irish EBF Hurry Harriet Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won a 1m Naas fillies' maiden at the second attempt despite showing signs of greenness (good); everything didn't go right at Galway (1m1f, yielding) on her handicap debut last time, so her close fourth there can be marked up; needs more at this level.

RaceName: Darley Irish EBF Hurry Harriet Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Highly tried last season, showing some pretty smart form when second in a Leopardstown Group 3 and when beaten under 4l in a Curragh Group 1; edged out subsequent Oaks winner Thundering On in her Leopardstown reappearance (1m, good to yielding); ran keenly in an Ascot Group 3 last month, but it was still a decent third; sets a good standard.

RaceName: Darley Irish EBF Hurry Harriet Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Sea The Stars filly was purchased for 160,000euros as a 2yo; impressed when winning on her Curragh debut last month (1m1f, good to firm), although it wasn't a strong contest; McDonogh remains aboard her and McMonagle rides Lemsairbat, which is a possible negative.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Made debut in June and he showed ability when fourth on his first two starts (6f/7f, good to firm/soft), the latest here; gelded since and this half-brother to Italian Group 3 winner Rainbow Royal is open to improvement.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well beaten for James Tate on sole 2yo start and not disgraced when fourth of six on recent stable and seasonal debut at Bath (5.7f, firm); however, others have much stronger form.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Mrs Wendy Jarrett & J S Moore
Spotlight: Fifth of seven on last month's debut at Ffos Las (5f, good) and second of six at Bath (5.7f, firm) subsequently; however, this looks a better race than last time and he needs another step forward.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 15,000euros foal, 40,000gns yearling; third foal; Sioux Nation sister to 5f/6f winner Shagraan (including Listed); dam 7f/1m winner (RPR 97); trainer also saddles Bold Shout, who has shown promise previously, and the betting could be informative on debut.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: She's shown some ability across her four starts and could be suited by this step back up to 6f; however, low-grade handicaps are likely to be a better pathway to success.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Soundly beaten on all three starts and improvement is necessary if she's to be a force this afternoon.

RaceName: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Finished first past the post in a maiden at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago but was demoted due to interference; she has her limitations but nevertheless holds leading claims in this field.

RaceName: Birthday Boy Leighton Happy 80th Handicap
Spotlight: No longer the force of old but was close third off today's career-low mark here (6f, good) eight days ago; eased in grade today and can handle the drop back to 5f; must be considered.

RaceName: Birthday Boy Leighton Happy 80th Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed 3yo; displayed improvement when second in Nottingham novice on last month's seasonal debut but was safely held when fifth of seven in subsequent Lingfield handicap (also 5f good to firm) and will clearly need to fare better here.

RaceName: Birthday Boy Leighton Happy 80th Handicap
Spotlight: Raced exclusively over 6f during seven-race career; soundly beaten in all four handicaps since winning AW maiden in September; drops in trip with tongue-tie added here; needs to get career back on track.

RaceName: Birthday Boy Leighton Happy 80th Handicap
Spotlight: Largely consistent mare who belatedly opened her account at Bath (5f, good) in June, her 19th start; also ran well when close third at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) on latest outing; shortlisted.

RaceName: Birthday Boy Leighton Happy 80th Handicap
Spotlight: Well beaten on first two outings but belied 200-1 odds when placed in Wolverhampton maiden (5f, AW) in June and it wil be interesting to see whether he can build on that performance on this handicap debut.

RaceName: Birthday Boy Leighton Happy 80th Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs A L Lofts & Mrs Nicky Scott Knight
Spotlight: Out of form for Tom Ward this season (four runs) and was just a respectable third of five for new stable at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) last week; visor removed after one use; needs to up her game.

RaceName: Birthday Boy Leighton Happy 80th Handicap
Spotlight: Came good for current stable at seventh attempt, with emphatic 5f AW win 12 days ago; will be fine back on turf and recent 5lb rise ought to be manageable; respected.

RaceName: Birthday Boy Leighton Happy 80th Handicap
Spotlight: Six-race maiden who did not look straightforward when fourth of seven at Chepstow (5f, good to firm) last month; that certainly wasn't a bad run but he needs the first-time cheekpieces to keep him focused here.

RaceName: Birthday Boy Leighton Happy 80th Handicap
Spotlight: Struggled on all three starts this season, most recently when last of nine in basement-grade Lingfield classified (1m, AW) last month; can't be recommended on this return to sprinting.

RaceName: Cayenne Electric At Porsche Centre Hull Handicap
Spotlight: Ten career wins divided between turf and the AW; well on top last time at Newcastle under Tom Kiely-Marshall but back up 5lb and it's been over two years since he defied a mark in the 70s.

RaceName: Cayenne Electric At Porsche Centre Hull Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins on the AW and 0-15 on turf, though has been running well at 1m-1m2f on grass this year without getting the job done; does have to bounce back from a poor one, however.

RaceName: Cayenne Electric At Porsche Centre Hull Handicap
Spotlight: Won a pair of 1m2f fast-ground Class 6s before found wanting in a Class 4 at York; might still be on a realistic mark and this is easier than last time.

RaceName: Cayenne Electric At Porsche Centre Hull Handicap
Spotlight: Six-time course winner and a regular here; beaten just over 2l over C&D last month when he was on the back foot after starting slowly; hard to rule out.

RaceName: Cayenne Electric At Porsche Centre Hull Handicap
Spotlight: 3-40 so not easy to win with, but last two victories have come over C&D and she was close up over 1m at Doncaster last time.

RaceName: Cayenne Electric At Porsche Centre Hull Handicap
Spotlight: Four wins here and nearly made that five last month on two occasions, since when he's again gone close at Pontefract; likely contender off the same mark as for last two runs.

RaceName: Cayenne Electric At Porsche Centre Hull Handicap
Spotlight: Snapped a losing run when over C&D last month and the race didn't go smoothly for him when third at Redcar; considered.

RaceName: Cayenne Electric At Porsche Centre Hull Handicap
OwnerName: Brian Ellison Racing Club & M Dale
Spotlight: Flat/hurdle winner; hasn't threatened in two runs since returning from a long absence and he's 3lb out of the weights.

RaceName: McEnery Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Group 3 winner over 1m2f at three; losing sequence stands at 14 since a Dundalk win early last year; flattered by his proximity to star stayer Scandinavia in a 1m6f Listed race at Navan in April; remote seventh behind Illinois in the Queen Alexandra; should not be ruled out on handicap debut.

RaceName: McEnery Cup Handicap
Spotlight: AW winner got off the mark on turf at the Curragh (1m2f, good-to-firm) in June; took a sharp rise in the ratings for that; well held by Navy Waters on Galway form.

RaceName: McEnery Cup Handicap
Spotlight: 1m4f Roscommon maiden winner in May; second of 24 on handicap debut at the Curragh in May (1m6f); ran respectably in 1m4f Cork Group 3; just behind the longer-priced pair Navy Waters and Star Harbour at the Curragh on latest.

RaceName: McEnery Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Produced several good displays last season, but his Ballinrobe win last month was his first since 2023; raised 6lb, not guaranteed to back that up; faces a rematch with third-placed Sea Coral.

RaceName: McEnery Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive this season, winning at Navan off 65 and at this venue off 78; failing to maintain his form when well fancied to complete in a premier handicap at the Curragh contested by several of these rivals; that was too bad to be true, unwise to discount.

RaceName: McEnery Cup Handicap
Spotlight: On a long losing run since his last win in September 2024; has had two of his last three starts in Britain; unplaced at Ripon last time, fine effort when second at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) behind subsequent Royal Ascot winner Opportunity; closely matched with Navy Waters on running at the Curragh in June.

RaceName: McEnery Cup Handicap
Spotlight: 2-13 on the Flat, both wins coming at Down Royal over 10.5f (good) and 1m5f (yielding) last season; consistent this season, never worse than fifth in five outings; looked unlucky in running when fifth of 18 at Galway, capable of getting in the mix.

RaceName: McEnery Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Has gone up a total of 13lb for wins at Ballinrobe and Tramore; good 7lb claimer booked here, but not sure to uphold Tramore form with third-placed Sea Coral.

RaceName: McEnery Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Below par first two runs this term; positives can be taken from her last two races; not without a chance of reversing Tramore form with Daboya and Ballinrobe form with War Rooms; worth noting how much market support she attracts relative to stablemate Marazion.

RaceName: McEnery Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Both Flat wins at this trip, a Curragh maiden on good in July 2024 and a Roscommon handicap (soft) last October; back from a spell over jumps to contest two Flat handicaps at Galway; 3lb out of the handicap here, 10lb claimer aboard; others preferred.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: She's 0-8 in Group 3 and Listed races but has finished runner-up in Listed contests in France on her last two starts (10.5f/1m4f, good/soft); there is every chance that she will be in the mix.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won 1m3f maiden at Dieppe last July; respectable fifth in Listed race at Pontefract (1m, good) last month; well beaten either side of that (1m/7f); goes back up in trip today but looks opposable.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who reappeared with easy win in C&D handicap (soft) last month; no match for the 1-2 winner when Listed second of five at York recently (1m2f, good to firm) but that performance entitles her to respect.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won three handicaps in a row (1m/7f, good/good to firm) prior to respectable sixth of 14 in handicap at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good) a fortnight ago; further improvement is necessary up in grade but this 3yo's pedigree suggests the step up in trip could be a plus and she's not discounted.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won her first two starts (1m/1m2f, AW/good) then finished second to subsequent Oaks runner-up Legacy Link in the Group 3 Musidora at York (1m2f, good); soundly beaten in the Group 1 Prix de Diane at Chantilly (1m2f, good to firm) last time but is in with a big shout now back down in grade.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won at Leicester (7f, good to soft) last September on sole 2yo start; both runs this season have been in novice races at Newbury, reappearing with a close second (1m1f, good to soft) and winning last time (1m2f, good to firm); this unexposed 3yo goes up in grade today but is a half-sister to two Listed winners and is in top hands, and could play a leading role.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Close Listed third at Goodwood (1m2f, good) in May and that form has worked out extremely well; tailed off in the Oaks at Epsom (1m4f, good to soft) next time and behind Regal Charm when fourth of five in Listed race at York (1m2f, good to firm) last time; not written off but has to raise her game.

RaceName: Meyer Timber EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a well-connected Listed winner; showed her inexperience and also significant promise when keeping on to take second behind a next-time-out winner at Lingfield (7f, AW) last month; respected.

RaceName: Meyer Timber EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 200,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Crack Of Light (9.4f/1m4f including Listed; RPR 101) and Cet Horizon (1m 2yo; 83); dam 11.6f-1m4f winner (94), closely related to 1m4f Group 2 winner Frankly Darling; stable has only occasional 2yo debut winners.

RaceName: Meyer Timber EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: First foal; dam 5f 2yo winner (RPR 90), sister to Group-placed 6f 2yo winner Squash, half-sister to 6f/7f winner Mount Mogan; stable not prolific with first-time-out 2yos.

RaceName: Meyer Timber EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a well-connected mare and cost 200,000gns at a breeze-up; runner-up in what looked a fairly good Doncaster novice (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; leading contender.

RaceName: Meyer Timber EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Finished last in two 6f Windsor novices races last month and can't be recommended here.

RaceName: Meyer Timber EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 135,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; sixth foal; half-brother to four winners including Likedbymike (Listed-placed 5f 2yo/6f; RPR 104); dam placed 6f 2yo (54); worth a glance in the betting but has good standard to reach on debut.

RaceName: Meyer Timber EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has excellent pedigree and cost 350,000gns as a yearling; displayed clear promise on recent debut at Thirsk (7f, good to firm), keeping on strongly for third, and ought to build on that performance here.

RaceName: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
OwnerName: Grange Park Racing Xviii And Ruth Carr
Spotlight: 2-2 since joining Ruth Carr, winning 5f handicaps at Thirsk last month and at Ripon last week; penalty for the latest small-field success demands more and a double-figure stall isn't ideal either.

RaceName: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
Spotlight: Just a neck behind Angel Numbers when second at Thirsk (5f, good to firm) last month and he is 7lb better off today; should remain competitive with conditions unlikely to bother him.

RaceName: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins last summer, including C&D (good to firm); this season has been tough going but she has been contesting stronger races than this one; not discounted.

RaceName: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed maiden; underwent wind surgery prior to last week's good third at Thirsk (5f, good; tongue tied first time); today's stiffer test will suit and he should have a bigger run in him soon.

RaceName: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
Spotlight: Placed in her three runs in maiden/novice company, recording her best RPR on AW (6f) in April; makes her handicap debut at a realistic level and the betting should be revealing.

RaceName: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
Spotlight: Good step forward when turning over the red-hot favourite in a 6f novice at Lingfield (good ground) in June; similar form when fourth in a handicap back at that track 18 days ago; more will be needed to come out on top here and she wouldn't want to be blowing the start from stall 2.

RaceName: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
Spotlight: Good series of efforts ground to a halt at York (5.4f, good to firm) 19 days ago; needs a full revival and she has copped the outside stall.

RaceName: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice over 6f on good ground in May; beaten favourite in his last four starts while leaving the impression this mark was still in range if things panned out better for him; shortlist material.

RaceName: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
Spotlight: Made all to win a 6f handicap at Ripon last month; creditable fifth at Doncaster 17 days later; well drawn to attack and should be quick enough for 5f; respected.

RaceName: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
Spotlight: Six-race maiden; no improvement for wind surgery when third of seven at Nottingham last month; drops back to 5f with a point to prove.

RaceName: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
Spotlight: Third in 5f handicaps on his last two starts, finishing behind Angel Numbers and Straight Ahead on the former occasion; dropped another 1lb but his stable may have stronger claims with Hanney Girl.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Huge odds and ran like it in a bumper and two Flat maidens; impossible to fancy.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt in bumpers at Wexford in July (2m1f, good); disappointing Flat debut at Ballinrobe later that month (1m5f, good to yielding); others preferred.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Profitable gelding was towards the rear throughout when tailed off in a Roscommon bumper (2m, yielding to soft) eight days ago; a lot of improvement needed but may improve for better ground.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: One of two for trainer; Romanised gelding showed ability in a barrier trial; confirmed promise with an excellent second on debut at the Curragh (1m, good) when a neck second behind the more experienced and now 91-rated Loughrea; gelded since then and should go well.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Unfancied in both maidens but didn't run badly over C&D in the second of those when a 4.25l fourth; gelded since running a career best in a Doncaster novice contest last time when a 3l third of five; place chance.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Placed five times from seven career starts, including when nailed on the line at Bellewstown in April (1m, soft), having tried to make all; runner-up again at Dundalk last time when a neck in front of Rock Of Claremont; his front-running style will suit this track and he's consistent.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Showed signs of greenness in his Curragh debut (1m, good, 66-1) but it was a creditable staying-on sixth all the same; needs to build on it

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Sent off at 66-1 for his debut at Killarney and was tailed off; looks elsewhere.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Got tired late on when fifth at the Curragh over 1m on debut (good); improved on the AW last time when taking third (neck behind Karrygrant); cheekpieces are added and he has the form to feature.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Superbly bred (sibling to three Group 1 winners); green when beaten 11l on debut at Dundalk in May; sported this headgear when chasing home an easy winner at Killarney next time (1m4f, good); needs more.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Fair fifth of 16 at Limerick on debut (7f, soft); didn't step forward for her new yard over 1m here when last of 13 (good); unlikely.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Sottsass filly; half-sister to 1m2f winner War Supremo (RPR 81); dam placed 10.6f-2m AW (75), closely related to 7f Group 3 winner Glowing, half-sister to useful 10.6f winner The Anvil, out of half-sister to 1m1f-1m2f Group 1/Grade 1 winner Beat Hollow; Gliondar is stable selected.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Made an eye-catching debut at Naas when a 5.25l seventh of 19 (1m, good), staying on well inside the final furlong; this extra 1.5 furlongs won't go astray.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Has showed improvement in each of her three maiden runs despite huge prices; fourth at Roscommon on return (7.5f, good, 80-1) when green and one place better at the Curragh next time (1m1f, good to firm, 125-1); place chance.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
Spotlight: Some promise in her debut and showed good improvement to take third of 17 at Naas next time (1m, good) in a tongue tie (retained); step up in trip could unlock a bit more.

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
Spotlight: Triple AW winner who is 0-24 on turf but he ran well to finish second behind an unexposed improver at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) 11 days ago; on same mark here and he's a big player if he can repeat that form.

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
Spotlight: Dual Polytrack winner last summer; returned after 279 days off with a fair effort at Kempton (1m4f) in May but he was disappointing on his return visit the following month; has bit to prove after that but he still has low mileage and his first win was on turf (1m2f, good).

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
Spotlight: Won on debut at Newmarket (7f, good) in July 2024 but she's 0-8 since and was tailed off on her reappearance at Kempton (1m4f, AW) in May; continues to drop down the weights but has plenty to prove after another break.

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
Spotlight: Returned after a gelding operation with a win at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) last month and he had an excuse when upped to 1m4f at Newmarket (took strong hold) next time; still looks feasibly treated on his penultimate form and he's an interesting contender back in trip.

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing I and Partner
Spotlight: Both wins have been on AW but he's run well on turf this season including when runner-up at Carlisle (1m) in May and when third over this trip at Windsor (good to firm) last time; continues to edge down the weights and he's in the mix with cheekpieces added.

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
Spotlight: Two creditable efforts at Epsom (8.5f/1m4f) from his three runs this season; could go well again back at his optimum trip but his last win was 13 months ago and he's ideally suited by good or slower ground.

RaceName: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
Spotlight: Hard to predict and has record of 1-15 but she bounced back with a good third in a Class 4 at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last month; has possibilities if she can back that up and she's still lightly raced on turf.

RaceName: Dandara Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Scored at Bath (1m, firm) on stable debut in May and has remained in pretty good form since; still on a workable mark; ought to be on the premises.

RaceName: Dandara Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Arrested decline on last two outings, more recently when beating King Of The Dance to win 7.3f classified race here (good) six weeks ago; has more on his plate in this handicap but still considered.

RaceName: Dandara Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden who became disappointing for Tom Ward, signing off for him with heavy defeat in first-time blinkers in May; goes without headgear on this stable debut; needs to have been reinvigorated by new regime.

RaceName: Dandara Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Safely held on all three starts since returning from nine-month absence in June and remains without a win since 2022; stable's other runner Nammos has less to prove.

RaceName: Dandara Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Very useful over middle distances in his prime but was badly out of sorts on AW during the winter and returned from break with disappointing 7f turf run in May; cheekpieces removed after one use; could be considered only if lively in the betting.

RaceName: Dandara Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Admirably consistent 7yo who chased home Angel's Call in 7.3f classified race here in June and was third over C&D in that grade a fortnight ago; probably in the mix again.

RaceName: Dandara Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-Irish 5yo who gained sole career win in spring 2024; down the field on both starts for new stable in June, the latter over C&D, and needs to turn things around; blinkers removed; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Dandara Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Scored over C&D last summer but that remains his only success from 38 starts, and he was well beaten over 1m2f on latest outing two months ago; others have more pressing claims.

RaceName: Dandara Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who ran on well from the rear to take second on handicap debut at Leicester (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago; competes off same mark here and could still have potential; respected.

RaceName: Dandara Homes Handicap
Spotlight: Showed nothing more than minor promise in his three qualifying races (all 7f) but makes his handicap debut from a workable mark and improvement is possible.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Ran respectably in a couple of handicaps earlier this season; several less encouraging displays before winning a claimer at Ballinrobe last month; big weight here on stable debut, Sam Coen's 5lb claim will help.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Struck a vein of good form at around this time last season, when placed at Naas and Leopardstown; reverts to the Flat after two runs over hurdles at Sligo; others preferred.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Four AW wins; 1-21 on turf; fair fifth at Leopardstown in June but down the field at Naas three weeks ago; stable had a Curgah winner last weekend.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Two Flat wins in 2024; unplaced in three Flat handicaps last month; not disgraced when set a very stiff task in a Galway novice hurdle; soundly beaten in a maiden hurdle at Roscommon last week.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Four wins in Britain for Ian Williams at 1m2f, ground-versatile; yet to find form for this stable; hard to fancy despite a much reduced mark, down 19lb since last December.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Has shown all his best form at Dundalk, won there in January, his first success at the 16th attempt; turf credentials are weak.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Showed a little on only start at two; has failed to build on that this season; hood and tongue-tie for the first time; champion jockey booked, so may not be a lost cause.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Beaten in excess of 10l in three handicap attempts; needs to raise her game; stable had a winner at Galway and another at Leopardstown last week.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Has attracted good support on all three starts for this stable; kept on well over 7f at Limerick for a never-dangerous sixth; had an excuse (coughing) when soundly beaten at Leopardstown; disappointing in a claimer at Ballinrobe last month.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Sole win came at Laytown last year; yet to make his presence felt this term; will need to show some sign of revival in advance of a likely return to the beach where he is trained.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Had fair AW form for Charlie Johnston during the winter, winning over 1m2f and runner-up over 1m4f; no Irish success yet, best effort when fourth at Fairyhouse three starts ago; taken out of an engagement at Ayr on Monday.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Second in a claimer at Ballinrobe in June; this opposition is more taxing, and he needs to step up on previous handicap form.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Mild promise at Dundalk and has run with some credit in two Fairyhouse handicaps; Colin Keane takes the ride for the first time, a tongue-tie is added to the cheekpieces worn last time.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Unconvincing form in maidens at three different trips; stable's good recent form provides some basis for optimism.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Modest form in maidens last year; down the field on handicap/seasonal debut at Fairyhouse six weeks ago.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: His two best displays (third of 15 and fifth of 15) were achieved at this track last season; recent form raises doubts; hood added now to tongue-tie.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: One of the more obvious contenders based on a C&D fourth and two good runs at Ballinrobe; was well supported last time and has a good chance of recovering losses.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sixth foal; half-sister to winners Cajole (7f/1m including AW/Listed; RPR 104), Theoryofeverything (Group-placed 7f-1m1f; 102) and Persist (1m/1m2f; 100); dam 1m winner (including 2yo/AW/Group 1; 121), half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Creative Force; with a top stable and makes strong appeal on paper.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 80,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; first foal; dam Listed-placed 6f winner (RPR 94), half-sister to winners Mammas Girl (7f Group 3), Master Of War (6f 2yo Listed) and Arabie (6f 2yo Group 2); has nice pedigree but stable is not prolific with first-time-out 2yos.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fifth foal; sister to winners Persian Force (5f/6f 2yo including Group 2; RPR 108) and Gubbass (Group-placed 5f-1m including 2yo/Qatar; 107); dam unraced half-sister to useful 7f winner Queen Of Power (dam of 6f Group 3 winner Garrus); no surprise if she features on debut.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a dual 7f Listed winner and made promising debut when fourth of 13 in Newbury novice (6f, good to firm) won by a smart filly six weeks ago; moves up in trip here; ought to play a major role.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 800,000gns yearling; sixth foal; closely related to 1m/1m1f winner Facteur Cheval (including UAE Group 1; RPR 122), half-sister to a US stakes winner; dam unraced half-sister to French 5f/6f Group 3 winner Tantheem; with that price tag she's an intriguing debutante.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Half-sister to an Italian Listed winner but was unable to justify her prominence in the betting when down the field on debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to firm) ten weeks ago.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sixth foal; sister to Group-placed 1m2f AW 2yo winner Empress Wu (RPR 100), half-sister to winners Fleur De Chine (7f-1m4f including Listed; 106) and Song Brocade (1m2f; 78); dam 1m 2yo winner (89), sister to 1m4f Group 1 winner Madame Chiang; drawn wide on debut and may find 7f a bit sharp.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Duaij Al Khalifa & Ahmad Al Qassimi
Spotlight: Out of a useful miler; towards rear throughout on her debut here (6f) five weeks ago but was only 3-1 for that and represents stable with excellent 2yo strike-rate; might get closer to the target today.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a Listed AW winner but was behind Marsala when a well-beaten 200-1 shot on debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) six weeks ago.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to a Hungarian 7f/1m3f winner; dam German 1m3f winner, half-sister to two US Grade 2 winners; less interesting than some of the other newcomers in this field.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to winners Holloway Boy (7f/1m including 2yo/AW/Group 3; RPR 118) and Humidity (6f/7f 2yo including Listed; 108); dam unraced sister to useful 6f-8.6f winner Supersta; one of two well-bred newcomers for her owners in this race.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a fairly useful 6f/7f AW winner; 50-1, showed only minor promise when fifth of seven in slowly run Newmarket novice (7f, goo to firm) last month; probably one for a bit further down the line.

RaceName: Golwg Gwendraeth 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)
Spotlight: Belied 50-1 odds when second of 22 at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) in March but this quirky customer has a very mixed record this year and spoiled his chance by pulling far too hard on his latest outing; others are much less risky.

RaceName: Golwg Gwendraeth 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)
Spotlight: Placed on soft ground in Germany in the autumn and also showed promise on last two of three British starts this year; remains unexposed; no surprise if he features on this handicap debut.

RaceName: Golwg Gwendraeth 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)
Spotlight: Bettered low-key handicap debut when fourth at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in June; pulled up there last month (jockey felt something was amiss) but may still have a bigger run in him if all goes to plan here.

RaceName: Golwg Gwendraeth 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)
Spotlight: Sometimes races a bit too freely but ran well before fading into fourth of ten at Newmarket (1m, good) in June and is now 3lb lower than when placed at Windsor (1m, good to firm) in May; good chance.

RaceName: Golwg Gwendraeth 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)
Spotlight: Six-race maiden; returned from break with two good efforts this summer, latterly when third of five at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) last month; should be fine over today's longer trip; likely contender.

RaceName: Golwg Gwendraeth 'Confined' Handicap (For horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)
Spotlight: Cut little ice in three 7f novice races in April-July and is not obviously well treated for this handicap debut but improvement is possible over the longer trip.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: In the frame in five consecutive outings this year before unplaced at Ballinrobe last time; may struggle to reverse form with the highly consistent Nibras Rainbow.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Has made little impact in maidens over 1m4f and 1m; has plenty of weight for her handicap debut; up against it.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Maiden who has run his best races at Leopardstown, placed there last August and in June; also fourth in a 22-race won by Nibras Rainbow; stayed on well from off the pace when sixth of 18 over 1m at Naas three weeks ago.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Has been highly dependable in recent months, two wins and three places from his last five starts; beat 21 rivals (including Medieval Night) at Leopardstown last month and has a good chance of reaching the money again following a Ballinrobe third that gives him an edge over Miss Crinshawn.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Won twice in Britain early in his career; was off for a long time; weak Irish form on the Flat and over hurdles since his return.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Useful form in 2024, featuring a Ballinrobe win; placed at the same venue during a light 2025 campaign; needs to step up considerably on what he has shown in two 2026 starts.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: P E Ryan & J G Shanahan
Spotlight: On a long losing sequence since a 1m Bellewstown success in the early part of last season; unplaced on his last six starts, others seem much more likely.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Some signs of winning potential; best run when fourth of 16 over 1m3f at Naas on penultimate start; well beaten over 1m5f at Down Royal and dropped in trip now.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Dual-purpose mare whose last two wins have come over hurdles; ran respectably in that sphere when fourth in a 20-runner handicap at Galway a fortnight ago; second in two of her Flat outings this year but beaten 12l on the second occasion and  appears held by Thegooseiscooked on running at Navan,

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Frankel filly has shown nothing in maidens over longer distances, finishing in front of only four of her 30 rivals; tongue-tie fitted now for first handicap; that will need to make a radical difference.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Weak form in bumpers and on AW at Dundalk; tailed off in a maiden hurdle at Punchestown in May; first-time blinkers.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: D P Coakley & J F Costello & A Connick & P Coakley
Spotlight: Inconsistent on turf last season; out of form at Dundalk last winter; never in contention at Leopardstown in April on his only turf start this year.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Two wins last year, at Tipperary and Clonmel; fifth behind Thegooseiscooked in this race 12 months ago; struggled in a 1m handicap at this venue in June.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Won this event last year, following several placed efforts during the summer; should be in peak form for her repeat bid after making a return to form at Navan a month ago, stayed on well after being denied a clear run; tongue-tie fitted for the first time, and Colin Keane aboard for the first time this season, underlining her chance.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Was running from 4lb of the handicap at Galway ten days ago and will be more at home in this grade; only 3lb higher than when winning for this rider at Ballinrobe last month.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Unraced at two and three and did not show much last season; bright start to the new campaign when fourth over 1m at Naas; made much of the running when second over C&D last month; holds a definite chance.

RaceName: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Still a maiden after 20 starts; solid display when fourth of 17 at Fairyhouse two months ago on her final start for a small County Tipperary yard; has joined a leading stable; possible that the change of scene will bear dividends.

RaceName: Unibet/Breeders Backing Racing EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Well on top at the finish in a Catterick bumper (good) in March and made good late progress to finish fifth of 20 in a Grade 2 at Aintree (2m1f, good to soft) the following month; interesting contender now switching to the Flat on her first start for 125 days with yard continuing in fine form.

RaceName: Unibet/Breeders Backing Racing EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Made a winning debut at Newbury (1m1f, good to soft; 8-1) in June but the runner-up reversed those placings back there over 1m2f last month (good to firm); this half-sister to the yard's 1m4f Group 1 winner Dubai Honour now steps up in trip for her AW debut and there should be more to come; stable has won this for the last two years.

RaceName: Unibet/Breeders Backing Racing EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Beat only one rival home on her debut at Southwell (1m, AW) in January but she built on that when upped to 1m2f at Lingfield in June, finishing second of 13 behind the odds-on favourite; enough in her pedigree to suggest she'll stay this longer trip; considered.

RaceName: Unibet/Breeders Backing Racing EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Promising second on her debut at Yarmouth last October and reappeared with an 8l fifth of ten at Sandown (1m2f, good) in a race won by the subsequent Musidora runner-up; ran to a similar level when fifth of six at Haydock (1m2f, soft) in May when last seen and leaves the impression this longer trip will suit.

RaceName: Unibet/Breeders Backing Racing EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Hooded when third of three on her debut at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) in June and ran to a similar level when second of four at Lingfield (1m4f, good to firm) four weeks ago; now switches to the AW and she may yet do better.

RaceName: Dress For The Occasions Handicap
OwnerName: Spiers & Hartwell Ltd & Mrs E Evans
Spotlight: Placed here (1m2f, good) in June, after a break, and not discredited when second of four over C&D (good) last month; remains well handicapped on some of his winter AW form and can make his presence felt again.

RaceName: Dress For The Occasions Handicap
Spotlight: Regressive 6yo who managed only third of four over C&D (good; first-time tongue-tie) last month and is now 0-5 for his new stable this year; cheekpieces (no obvious effect when used twice last season) are given another whirl; revival needed.

RaceName: Dress For The Occasions Handicap
Spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles but made winning Flat handicap debut over C&D (good) a fortnight ago, clinging on well to cause a 40-1 surprise; only 2lb higher today and further progress is possible.

RaceName: Dress For The Occasions Handicap
Spotlight: Back in prime form with two wins in July, the latter by a nose in small field at Bath (1m6f, good to firm); only 1lb higher here and can cope with the drop back in trip; probably won't be far away.

RaceName: Dress For The Occasions Handicap
Spotlight: Went to a whole new level when drawing 10l clear over C&D (good) eight days ago, her third win of the year; that race developed into a stamina test and the form is treated with a degree of caution but, nevertheless, she commands respect under a 6lb penalty.

RaceName: Dress For The Occasions Handicap
Spotlight: Safely held over 1m in his first two handicaps; remains unexposed but is not bred to benefit from this hike up in trip and needs significant improvement.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: All six wins have been on turf, the most recent at Chester (7.5f, good to firm) in May 2024 off a 9lb higher mark than today's; back to form when a front-running second here over 1m in June; below his best at Chester 32 days ago but he has a handy draw and is capable of bouncing back.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Three wins last year, two on the AW (2-4 on sand); good fourth of ten at Newmarket (7f, good) in June but he's been below his best in two starts since; may do better returned to this surface.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Four wins from 37 starts, the most recent at Chelmsford (7f, AW) in December; got behind early at Southwell last time after short of room leaving the stalls but then kept on into seventh; each-way contender with refitted cheekpieces replacing regular hood.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Dual winner (7f/1m) who has posted some good efforts at this track, including when runner-up over this C&D in March off a 4lb higher mark; two solid runs since joining this stable and has to be considered with first-time visor replacing cheekpieces.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Four-time winner (5f/6f) but he's 0-8 since joining this stable; below his best in recent starts but now drops down in grade, albeit with stamina to prove for this longer trip; others more persuasive.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Dual 6f AW winner, most recently at Wolverhampton last April off a 4lb higher mark; well beaten on turf on her first two outings this year but she did run respectably on the AW 12 days ago; cheekpieces added; suspicion she may be at her best over 6f.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: 0-9 on the AW but he has gone close on two occasions, including when beaten a head at Lingfield (7f) in December; below his best on his next two outings and was last of seven at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last month; needs to take a step forward.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Three wins include one here (1m) in April off a 2lb lower mark; below that level on turf in two starts since and drops back to 7f for the first time since his debut, which would be a concern.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Dual course winner over 1m; unable to kick on from his stable debut last year but he did run okay when fourth at Newmarket (7f, good) on reappearance in June; may improve on that first outing in 226 days.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Can lead; all eight wins on the AW, five over this C&D; faded into midfield having been drawn wide here in May and soft ground can be given as an excuse for failing to beat a rival at Goodwood (1m) two months ago; could go well back on this surface.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Won a soft-ground 6f maiden at Chepstow last September but he's struggled in four handicaps since, most recently when fading inside the final furlong over this trip at Southwell two weeks ago; others preferred.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div I)
Spotlight: Five-time winner on turf but 0-11 on the AW; has struggled since winning at Bellewstown (5f, soft) last October and was always behind on his stable debut at Lingfield (5f, AW) last month; steps back up in trip; best watched.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Well held in three turf handicaps (Class 3) this season but he's 2-3 on AW and his last win was off just 1lb higher over C&D last November; with another new yard (changed hands for £16,000) but it wouldn't be a surprise if he made a bold bid back on Polytrack.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Won in first-time cheekpieces at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) in April; reached the frame in next two starts but his form nosedived in a big field at Ascot (last of 16) last time; has a bit to prove after that but this is a big drop back in grade and he's a player if he can bounce back.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)
