Spotlight: His last win was in April 2024 but he hasn't been with John Butler for long and he showed signs of a revival when fourth at Newcastle (1m, AW) last month; has claims if he can build on that and he should be fine back at this trip.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Seven-time AW winner and the latest three have been over C&D; has mixed record for new trainer this season but he was runner-up at Southwell last time and remains feasibly treated off only 1lb higher than for his win here in May; key player.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: Cottier, Racing Breaks & Old Gold Racing
Spotlight: Added to his five turf wins when making all to beat 13 rivals at Newcastle (1m, Tapeta) in June; 5lb higher from wide draw here but he still looks on a workable mark and is lightly raced on AW; respected back in trip.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Emphatic winner off 2lb lower at Southwell (1m, AW) last December but she's been disappointing since and was beaten 14l at Newmarket (last of six) in June; has questions to answer and she needs a major revival after a short break; tongue-tie returns with first-time hood.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 6f win at Lingfield (Polytrack) for Harry Charlton; his best effort in four runs for current yard was a second at Newbury in June but he's not easy to predict and was disappointing at Windsor last time; risks attached.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)
OwnerName: J Machale, S Tucker & S Jewell
Spotlight: 5-21 on AW compared to 0-11 on grass; struggled off his lower turf mark at Epsom four weeks ago but he had reappeared with a creditable effort here previously and his last success was over C&D; could be dangerous if he gets a good pace and some luck.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Reappeared with a 6f win here in April but she's not come close to that form since and was tailed off at Newmarket last month; now only 1lb higher than for her last success but she needs a big turnaround.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: Seven-time AW winner who was runner-up over C&D in March but has lost his way with heavy defeats in his last three runs; has a lot to prove and he needs to get back on track.

RaceName: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div II)
Spotlight: His three AW wins have all been at Kempton including two over C&D; made the breakthrough on turf at Yarmouth in May and he's run respectably there in his last two starts; now goes back up in grade but he's not ruled out back on Polytrack.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Winning debut on AW at Wolverhampton (7f) last March but was well held in two handicaps later; however, he posted a solid effort when third at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) on reappearance, having undergone wind/gelding operations, and should come on for that; this return to 1m could suit.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Made all in a 0-95 at Lingfield (7.5f, good to firm) in May off a 3lb lower mark than today's but he did too much too soon over 1m2f at Sandown two months ago; dropping back in trip should suit this C&D winner.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Runner-up in two AW novice events in 2024 and 2025, and got off the mark at the seventh attempt when landing a handicap at Chepstow (1m, good to firm) in June; he's lightly raced and unexposed over this trip, so could have more to offer.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Built on his stable debut when winning in first-time cheekpieces at Ffos Las (1m, good to soft) in June and followed up next time over that same C&D, taking his record in headgear to 3-3 (won in first-time blinkers for Roger Varian); 3lb higher but respected on his return to the AW.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Sole win from 19 starts came in a Salisbury maiden on his second start in 2023; has posted a couple of good efforts for this stable, including when beaten a neck at Lingfield (1m2f, AW; first-time hood)  in February; cheekpieces are quickly discarded after a poor run here over 1m3f latest.

RaceName: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Four-time winner over 7f, the most recent coming on the AW at Newcastle last November; never featured after missing the break at Chester (7f, good to soft) two months ago and needs to take a big step forward from that reappearance.
